text:
The home mountain of the Greek Gods is Mount Olympus.

To understand the concept in the content, imagine the Internet is like a massive, chaotic city where every building is a website and every room inside those buildings is a web page. If you are looking for a specific room, say the "Kitchen," trying to walk through every building one by one would take forever. A search engine acts like a super-efficient city guide or a librarian who has memorized the floor plan of every building. Instead of you wandering aimlessly, you simply ask the guide, "Where is the Kitchen?" and they point you directly to the correct building and room, saving you from getting lost in the vastness of the city.
